name: Heeding the Call
summary: Turak Runetotem calls you to begin learning the ways of the bear. He teaches that druids serve nature and preserve balance.

sections.title: A Call to Learn
sections.body:
Turak Runetotem on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff asks you to speak with him. He says the time has come for you to take a first step into a larger world.

He teaches that Cenarius' children serve nature, caring for animals and plants as friends and charges. Your first lesson is the ways of the bear, and strength of body and heart.

faq.q: Who is asking me to come here?
faq.answer: Turak Runetotem asks you to speak with him on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: What does Turak want me to learn?
faq.answer: Turak says your first step is to learn the ways of the bear and strength of body and heart.

faq.q: What does Turak say druids do?
faq.answer: Turak says Cenarius' children serve nature and preserve balance for the sake of animals, plants, and themselves.

faq.q: Where do I speak with Turak?
faq.answer: Turak Runetotem is on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As a druid, Turak's teaching begins with service to nature and learning the ways of the bear.

attribution: In-game quest text: Heeding the Call
